description: Admin Answer Moderation — create community_moderation_screen.dart in admin_dashboard, add /community route to admin_router.dart, add Community sidebar item to admin_shell.dart. Independent of FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Create `admin_dashboard/lib/presentation/screens/community/community_moderation_screen.dart`. It is a ConsumerWidget. Import adminApi from core/utils/api_client.dart, AdminColors from app/theme/admin_theme.dart. Define two FutureProviders: adminQuestionsProvider = FutureProvider<List<Map<String,dynamic>>>((ref) async { final resp = await adminApi.get('/community/questions', params: {'limit': '50'}); final data = resp.data['data'] as List? ?? []; return data.cast<Map<String,dynamic>>(); }); adminQuestionAnswersProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose.family<List<Map<String,dynamic>>, String>((ref, questionId) async { final resp = await adminApi.get('/community/questions/$questionId'); final raw = resp.data['data'] ?? resp.data; if (raw is Map) { final answers = raw['answers'] as List? ?? []; return answers.cast<Map<String,dynamic>>(); } return []; }); Build method: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28), ...) containing a Column: _PageHeader (same as in moderation_screen.dart — title 'Community Moderation', subtitle 'Verify student answers'), SizedBox(height: 24), then adminQuestionsProvider.when(loading, error, data). For data: ListView.builder of questions, each wrapped in an ExpansionTile (title: Text(q['title'])), subtitle: Text('${q['answerCount'] ?? 0} answers'), expandedCrossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start. When expanded, fetch adminQuestionAnswersProvider(q['id']).when — loading shows LinearProgressIndicator; data shows a Column of _AnswerModerationCard widgets.

2. Add _AnswerModerationCard widget at the bottom of community_moderation_screen.dart (private StatefulWidget extending ConsumerStatefulWidget). Props: answer Map<String,dynamic>, onVerified VoidCallback. It shows a Card with: author name (from answer['author']?['firstName'] + lastName or fallback 'Student'), answer body (answer['body']), and either a green 'Verified' badge Container (if answer['isVerified'] == true) or an ElevatedButton(style: success background, label 'Verify', onPressed: _verify). _verify calls adminApi.patch('/community/answers/${answer['id']}/verify') then calls onVerified() which triggers ref.invalidate(adminQuestionAnswersProvider(questionId)). Show SnackBar on success/error with AdminColors.success / AdminColors.error. Use AdminColors throughout, Nunito fontFamily.

3. Add static const String community = '/community' to the AdminRoutes class in `admin_dashboard/lib/app/router/admin_router.dart`. Add import for CommunityModerationScreen. Add GoRoute(path: AdminRoutes.community, builder: (_, __) => const CommunityModerationScreen()) to the ShellRoute routes list.

4. Add 'Community' to the _navItems const list in `admin_dashboard/lib/presentation/shell/admin_shell.dart`. Insert it after the Moderation item (index 2) and before Departments: _NavItem(icon: Icons.forum_outlined, label: 'Community', route: AdminRoutes.community). No other changes to the file.
5. Verify: flutter analyze in admin_dashboard (no issues).
acceptance_criteria: Screen loads questions from GET /community/questions?limit=50 via adminApi
Each question renders as an ExpansionTile showing answers when expanded
Unverified answers show a 'Verify' button; verified answers show a green 'Verified' badge
/community GoRoute is registered in the ShellRoute
Community sidebar item appears in admin_shell.dart _navItems after Moderation
flutter analyze in admin_dashboard reports no issues
findings:
Implemented FEAT-004 (Flutter-only, backend PATCH /community/answers/:id/verify already exists).

Files created/modified:
- Created admin_dashboard/lib/presentation/screens/community/community_moderation_screen.dart (ConsumerWidget screen + adminQuestionsProvider + adminQuestionAnswersProvider.autoDispose.family + _QuestionTile + _AnswerModerationCard + _PageHeader).
- admin_dashboard/lib/app/router/admin_router.dart: added AdminRoutes.community = '/community', import, and GoRoute inside the ShellRoute.
- admin_dashboard/lib/presentation/shell/admin_shell.dart: inserted Community _NavItem (Icons.forum_outlined) after Moderation and before Departments.

Notes / deviations from the literal step text (all preserve intended behaviour, no user-facing product change):
1. Questions list response shape: the backend ResponseInterceptor wraps responses in { success, data, message }, and GET /community/questions returns { questions: [...], total } inside data. The literal step code `resp.data['data'] as List? ?? []` would ALWAYS yield an empty list (data is a Map, not a List), which would violate the acceptance criterion 'Screen loads questions from GET /community/questions?limit=50'. The provider instead extracts data['questions'] when data is a Map, and falls back to a flat list if data is a List — matching the proven pattern in web_app community_screen.dart.
2. Answers provider: handles the real shape { data: { question, answers } } (raw['answers']) plus a flat-list fallback, per the 'handles both shapes' requirement.
3. Lazy fetch on expand: each question is wrapped in a stateful _QuestionTile that only watches adminQuestionAnswersProvider when its ExpansionTile is expanded. This matches the step intent 'When expanded, fetch...' and avoids firing 50 detail requests on screen load.
4. _AnswerModerationCard is a ConsumerStatefulWidget with answer + questionId props; _verify calls adminApi.patch('/community/answers/:id/verify'), shows a SnackBar (AdminColors.success / AdminColors.error), and invalidates adminQuestionAnswersProvider(questionId) so the Verified badge appears after refresh.
5. Answer author name: the Answer entity has authorId but NO nested author object (the service only enriches questions with author names). The card therefore falls back to 'Student' for every answer author, exactly as the step spec dictates. Showing real answer-author names would require a backend change (enrich answers with author), which is out of scope for this Flutter-only FEAT.
